# Design tokens, as the phone actually renders them

<!-- Generated by tools/ui-parity/extract.php from resources/css/app.css.
     Do not edit by hand: re-run the script. -->

Every value here is read out of `resources/css/app.css`, not estimated. Sizes are
in px at the 16px root this app never changes.

## The thing to get right first

Inside the signed-in shell (`body.cn-app`) on a screen under 768px, **every font
size is 1.25x the desktop value**. The public landing page is excluded, and
spacing and fixed heights are deliberately *not* scaled — the override enlarges
text only, rather than zooming the interface.

So reading a Tailwind class at its documented size gives the wrong answer on a
phone. Use the mobile column:

| Class | Desktop | **Phone** |
|---|---|---|
| `text-xs` | 12px | **15px** |
| `text-sm` | 14px | **17.5px** |
| `text-base` | 16px | **20px** |
| `text-lg` | 18px | **22.5px** |
| `text-xl` | 20px | **25px** |
| `text-2xl` | 24px | **30px** |
| `text-3xl` | 30px | **37.5px** |
| `text-4xl` | 36px | **not overridden** |
| `text-5xl` | 48px | **not overridden** |

The views also use 10 arbitrary sizes, each with its own phone value:

| Class | Phone |
|---|---|
| `text-[6px]` | 8px |
| `text-[7px]` | 9px |
| `text-[8px]` | 10px |
| `text-[9px]` | 11px |
| `text-[10px]` | 13px |
| `text-[11px]` | 14px |
| `text-[12px]` | 15px |
| `text-[13px]` | 16px |
| `text-[14px]` | 18px |
| `text-[15px]` | 19px |

**Shared bar gradient** (`.bg-cm-bar-gradient`, used by `.yard-header`, `.mp-header`
and the GoMarket mobile bar, so every branded bar reads as one surface):

```
linear-gradient(135deg, #015083 0%, #01395e 60%, #012a47 100%)
```

## Typeface

```
'Inter', 'DM Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji',
        'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Noto Color Emoji'
```

Inter is the real face; everything after it is fallback. The app must ship Inter
as a bundled asset — a phone will not have it, and falling back to the system
font changes every metric on every screen.
